test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the pair which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two set of pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

KIJ−NLM

YWX−BZA
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6e03992242b34856e7209290be57460f3c367fcc832e0373ac675e2218f6b44.png] 

Given: 

KIJ−NLM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d8fd58109e29be36d26c96adf9c47c333107a73e5614c79bca160d5106e9691.png] 

YWX−BZA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19b1c5be0348316de08b4d9e789f75ece46e1e69f195def898a412a7bf983744.png] 

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +3, +3, +3.

Let’s check each option:

1. IFF–KIJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77a733db0838465f9aab66d79de1615433f78bdf2f642fa07edce82ae951d4d9.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +3, +3, +3.

2. IGH–KJJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bddd7cbb8fe47d28b592697b719187dbc90fb3dec36ca48837919e432248acb.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +3, +3, +3.

3. IFF–LJK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/206be9c2996b6afda48ac96b45c842ddb103b00214f5d51771c3b1a398688ec9.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +3, +3, +3.

4. IGH–LJK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d53c7047718be571d31ad1976afb1d45b85eabd7e6c6084042fb4993329a3b1.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +3, +3, +3.

Thus, IGH–LJK follows the same pattern as that followed by the two set of pairs given.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
